name: The Toll's Lip
story: The inn is built into the crater rim, and its cellar is the inside of the Toll's lip: forty feet of bronze for a back wall, which keeps the ale at one temperature all year and makes every conversation down there sound like it matters.
who_was_here: Three generations of Cresswells, and everyone in Merrowby, most nights.
unique_object: a cellar wall of bronze bell, with two hundred years of names scratched into it at sitting height
